title: Late Reissue Interest Rates for Returned Income Annuities Installments
content:
Interest on a reissued Ashgrove Income Annuities installment is added at the group delay rate of **6% (0.0600)** for a contract issued in Connecticut, Minnesota, New Jersey or New York when more than **30** days (the group late days) have passed since its payment date, and at the other-state late rate of **5% (0.0500)** for a contract issued in any other state when more than **60** days (the other-state late days) have passed since that date. Days are calendar days from the installment's payment date to the reissue date. Where neither describes the reissue, neither of these rates applies.

Interest at either rate is simple, worked on the reissued installment for the days of interest over 365, and rounded to the cent.

| State of issue | Days from payment date to reissue | Rate |
|---|---|---|
| Connecticut, Minnesota, New Jersey, New York | 31 or more | 6% |
| Connecticut, Minnesota, New Jersey, New York | 30 or fewer | Neither applies |
| Any other state | 61 or more | 5% |
| Any other state | 60 or fewer | Neither applies |

**Edges (hypothetical payment date 1 May).** Minnesota contract reissued 31 May (30 days): neither rate; reissued 1 June (31 days): 6%. Georgia contract reissued 30 June (60 days): neither; 1 July (61 days): 5%.

**Figure (hypothetical).** $1,250.00 at 6% simple for 45 days over 365: $9.2466, so $9.25.
